title: NNSA recurring qualified rate receives a bounded immutable-history recovery drill
summary: Recovery reconstructs reader state only from complete immutable lifecycle history, notices, the controlling manifest, provenance export, and signed release index, then appends a nonactivating receipt without rewriting or automatically displaying anything.
